## Tutorials and practice

- [Learn the Basics (PyTorch)](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/basics/intro.html){.external target='_blank'} — official beginner tutorial: tensors, data, a model, and the training loop, on FashionMNIST.
- [TrenTorch](https://trentorch.com/){.external target='_blank'} — practice problems for learning ML by writing it, including building PyTorch pieces and coding papers.
- [TensorFlow Playground](http://playground.tensorflow.org/#activation=tanh&batchSize=10&dataset=circle&regDataset=reg-plane&learningRate=0.03&regularizationRate=0&noise=0&networkShape=4,2&seed=0.21559&showTestData=false&discretize=false&percTrainData=50&x=true&y=true&xTimesY=false&xSquared=false&ySquared=false&cosX=false&sinX=false&cosY=false&sinY=false&collectStats=false&problem=classification&initZero=false&hideText=false){.external target='_blank'} — an in-browser demo: tweak the network, the data, and the learning rate, and watch it learn. This link opens a ready-made classification preset.
